name: Bestial Transformation
disable: DC 26 Nature check (expert) to handle the animal carvings or DC 33 Thievery check (master) to scratch out the animal carvings or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the spell

items.name: Animal Form
items.text:
Trigger A creature damages the door

---

Effect The trap casts Bestial Curse on the triggering creature (DC 32 Fortitude save save); on a critical failure, the duration is 2 hours.

text: Enchanted carvings of animals transform any creatures who damage the door into the animal they harmed.
